selected.source_semantic_law: Return only class-declared direct slot-definition metaobjects; exclude inherited slot definitions even though effective CLASS-SLOTS includes them.
positive_witnesses: Parent P owns slot a; child C declares b: direct C slot names include b but exclude inherited a.
For parent P, its direct slot definitions include a; no-value class has empty direct slot set.
selected.falsifier: Returning effective inherited slot list as direct class slots.

selected.source_semantic_law: For finalized class C, return a linearized list of class metaobjects with C first, T last, each class/superclass exactly once, respecting source-superclass precedence.
positive_witnesses: Single inheritance child C of P: C precedes P and T, no duplicates.
Distinct parent order influences the computed precedence under compatible local precedence rules.
selected.falsifier: Returning only direct superclasses, duplicated class objects or alphabetical/sorted order is not class precedence.

selected.source_semantic_law: Read the set of exact method metaobjects attached to a generic function; adding/removing a method changes membership without invoking any method body.
positive_witnesses: Generic G with integer and string methods: introspection returns precisely both method metaobjects.
Remove integer method: introspection still returns string method, without deleting generic G.
selected.falsifier: Confuse applicable-method selection for current arguments with registered method-object membership.

selected.source_semantic_law: Return the permutation of required generic-function parameter names specifying argument precedence for method specificity, not parameter types or method objects.
positive_witnesses: Generic with two required parameters and an explicitly reversed precedence order returns the reversed symbol sequence.
Order contains each required parameter once and excludes optional/rest parameters.
selected.falsifier: Return default lambda-list textual order when a distinct explicit precedence order was specified.
